findings.why: Fewer clientSecret errors for resubmitted providers fits c1, but the new version also stops reporting a blank clientId on provider 0, which no claim predicts; both versions still reject the request with 400.

A partial PATCH that only disables oauth2 now fails with 400 'invalid formatting' instead of succeeding, and re-enabling with a single provider lacking clientId/clientSecret now succeeds instead of 400; no claim covers either change.
